Thomas looked out across the grey horizon, smiled softly, and slipped the note into his coat pocket.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市隐没在沉沉的夜色中，路灯散发着昏黄而孤寂的光晕。街道上空无一人，偶尔有几辆疾驰而过的汽车打破片刻的寂静，轮胎与湿润路面的摩擦声格外清晰。远处的写字楼里只有几处零星的窗户亮着灯，那是值班人员疲惫的身影。空气中弥漫着清晨特有的微凉雾气，树叶在夜风中沙沙作响。整个世界仿佛陷入了沉睡，正在积蓄力量等待第一缕晨光的唤醒。", "w03": "First, you write a function that performs a small part of a big task and calls itself with a simpler version of the same problem.\nSecond, you must always include a base case so the function knows when to stop calling itself and return a final result.\nThird, every self-call gets you closer to that base case until the entire problem is solved piece by piece."}
